label: Whether Form 8949 work is in the class with code B corrections

fact_types.title: Whether this return's Form 8949 work is only (1) sales your broker reported to the IRS with their basis, with no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss or a correction of a wrong reported basis (code B, column (e) the basis shown and column (g) the correction), and (2) sales of stocks or other securities in boxes B, C, E and F, each recorded once under the one box its statement gives it, with a basis you supply that is the correct basis even where a Form 1099-B showed another (and, on boxes C and F, net proceeds you supply), and an optional wash-sale adjustment. yes or no.
Did any Form 1099-B or substitute statement you received show a cost or other basis, reported to the IRS, that is wrong?
